embedding_method.hook: Upstream MTMD_DEBUG_EMBEDDINGS=<path>, built into installed libmtmd; no code patch/recompile.
embedding_method.position: Final visual encoder/projector output before text-model decoding.
embedding_method.caveat: Readback enabled in three extra fresh-process runs. Not all intermediate tensors were captured. Serialized output is close, not bitwise equal: relative L2 about1.22%, cosine0.999926.

full_page_validation.comparison_scope: Same machine, weights, advanced/OCR/page1 and default thread settings. Single full serialized run; CPU baseline was collected earlier in this session, not a repeated randomized performance study.

kernel_watchdog_evidence.runtime_read_note: /sys/module/i915/parameters/request_timeout_ms is root-only. sudo -n read was unavailable; no values changed.20000ms is the verified kernel build default, not a directly read live parameter.
kernel_watchdog_evidence.observed_stage: Default GPU image encoding returns after roughly22s and logs8 fence expirations; serialized image encoding completes after roughly70s without cancellation.
kernel_watchdog_evidence.kernel_action: intel_gt_watchdog_work prints the observed message and calls i915_request_cancel(rq,-EINTR).
kernel_watchdog_evidence.ggml_action: The installed pinned source queues graph submissions by default. serialize_submissions waits/resets a fence between submitted graph sections.
kernel_watchdog_evidence.interpretation: High-confidence interaction of ggml-vulkan submission strategy and i915 request watchdog, with failure not surfaced as a fatal inference error. No clean-room Mesa/kernel version bisect was performed.

texts: 文字、公式和表格转换为结构化内容，支持检索与分析。
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Page 123 of 456.

onnx_relation.conclusion_zh: 共享 Mesa ANV/i915 驱动栈，但当前默认 NHWC 原始 rec 图在0.297秒首次推理即输出六条空文本，整个进程2.481秒，无 fence/GPU HANG 日志。不能用约20秒 watchdog 取消解释这次错误；不能把两个异常认定为同一根因。
onnx_relation.prior_context: Other compact/prefix/full-document ONNX cases have triggered GPU HANG; this experiment does not identify their shader or prove all ONNX failures share one mechanism.
onnx_relation.ggml_environment_scope: GGML_VK_SERIALIZE_SUBMISSIONS is read by ggml-vulkan, not by ORT/Dawn. It is not an ONNX fix.

recommendation_zh: 本机 llama.cpp Vulkan 可用进程级串行提交规避已复现的错误；单页恢复后仍比CPU慢约2.85倍，因此默认CPU仍合理。启用范围应限制到实际目标Vulkan设备/驱动，不把规则扩展到AMD/NVIDIA、DML或所有Intel架构。先验证更多页型再考虑生产默认。
remaining_limits: No direct read of live root-only watchdog parameter.
No kernel/Mesa driver replacement, no llama-version bisect.
No capture of every intermediate shader tensor or driver fence error propagation.
One full-page correctness validation; serialized GPU numerical output is not bitwise CPU-identical.
Existing ONNX architecture policy and production llama routing are unchanged.

sources.supports: Exact observed fence-expiration message and request cancellation action.
Watchdog timer scheduling and expiration handling.
Serialized submissions wait for completion between graph sections.
External same-UHD770 reproduction and serialized-submission mitigation; treated as corroboration, not sole proof.
Related request-timeout investigation across Intel compute runtimes; not claimed to be the same software path.
